# vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests

## Overview

Tests for the SPIR-V [`OpBranchConditional`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L105) instruction, specifically verifying behavior when both branch targets are the same label (`%live`). The source registers both true and false condition values through the shared [`conditions`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L47) array.

## Test Families

### same_labels_true — Same-label branch with true condition

Tests [`OpBranchConditional`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L105) where both the true and false labels point to the same block (`%live`), with the condition set to `%true` via [`OpConstantTrue`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L88). The dead code block (`%dead`) stores the sentinel value `2863311530` and should never execute, as shown by the compute dead block and live block stores in [`addComputeSameLabelsTest()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L96-L112).

Observed in [`addComputeSameLabelsTest()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L49-L126) and [`addGraphicsSameLabelsTest()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L128-L218).

### same_labels_false — Same-label branch with false condition

Tests [`OpBranchConditional`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L105) where both the true and false labels point to the same block (`%live`), with the condition set to `%false` via [`OpConstantFalse`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L89). Despite the false condition, the branch should still go to the same target label.

Observed in [`addComputeSameLabelsTest()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L49-L126) and [`addGraphicsSameLabelsTest()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L128-L218).

## Support Requirements

- **vertexPipelineStoresAndAtomics** — required for graphics tests via [`features.coreFeatures.vertexPipelineStoresAndAtomics`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L143).
- **fragmentStoresAndAtomics** — required for graphics tests via [`features.coreFeatures.fragmentStoresAndAtomics`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L144).
- Stage-specific graphics feature checks are handled by [`createTestsForAllStages()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L215-L216); this page does not add unsupported source claims for individual tessellation or geometry checks.

## Verification Methods

- **Compute**: The expected output buffer is populated with sequential values (`0`, `1`, `2`, ..., `numItems - 1`) before the test case is created in [`addComputeSameLabelsTest()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L55-L57) and attached as the expected output in [`spec.outputs`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L122). Each invocation stores its index via the live branch; if the dead branch executed, the sentinel value would be stored instead in the dead block at [`OpStore %35 %uint_unused`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L110-L112).
- **Graphics**: The expected output buffer is populated with sequential values in [`addGraphicsSameLabelsTest()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L136-L141) and passed through [`GraphicsResources`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L132-L141) to [`createTestsForAllStages()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L215-L216).

## Notes

- This is a focused test file with two condition variants per pipeline type, generated by the loop over [`conditions`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L59-L64) for compute and the equivalent graphics loop in [`addGraphicsSameLabelsTest()`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L148-L153).
- The test specifically targets the edge case where [`OpBranchConditional`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L105) has identical true/false labels, which is valid SPIR-V but may expose driver bugs in dead code elimination or control flow handling.
- The sentinel value `2863311530` (`0xAAAAAAAA`) is used in the dead code block to detect incorrect execution in compute at [`%uint_unused`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L96) and in graphics at [`%uint_unused`](../../../modules/vulkan/spirv_assembly/vktSpvAsmConditionalBranchTests.cpp#L163).
